patches.purpose: Dump the GSP display register file and PC, which Lua cannot read (BUGS.md MD-04) and which -video none prevents the scanline callback from dumping.
Dump GSP VRAM and display parameters to a directory.
Dump display parameters alongside the VRAM dump.
Record raw offset and post-transform register index for 68010 stores into the TMS34010 host interface, to settle whether hd68k_gsp_io_w sees a byte offset or a word index.
Executed-opcode profiler: which TMS34010 ops the game uses and in what proportion.

Instruction-fetch trace from ROPCODE(), the only choke point every executed instruction passes through. Answers whether the GSP fetches instructions at all and from where, which no existing instrumentation can.
Build stamp. The frozen oracle reads '(Local Build)'; stunrun-observe reads the commit.

MD-12 triage. internal_regs_map exposes offsets 0x00-0x1ff while m_IOregs holds 64 entries and IOREG() indexes it unmasked. Prints sizeof(m_IOregs), the byte delta to m_shiftreg, and where each out-of-bounds offset actually lands, rather than inferring it from the class layout.
